summary: The baseline built green before any edit. RuleCases.ps1 now removes every scratch folder through Remove-ScratchDir ([IO.Directory]::Delete, then a hand walk that clears ReadOnly and unlinks links, then a counted `cleanup:` FAIL). All of its folders sit in one `fsa-rulecases-<hex>` root, placed by Get-ScratchParent, a mirror of TempTree.ChooseTestsRoot. B-008's root is padded to 250 characters and gives 428 under both TEMPs. SyncRootRig takes its parent from CloudRig.PrepareParent (choose, create, sweep), and the CloudPlaceholderTests.cs exemption is gone. The acceptance test passes unchanged, and `-Case All` with the engine python passes under both C:\WINDOWS\TEMP and the user's TEMP. From the tree the engine handed over, I kept the acceptance test byte-identical and the engine-appended RuleCases fitness rule, and removed the engine-appended WindowCases rule per M1.

SyncRootRig constructor uses CloudRig.PrepareParent; the exemption comment is rewritten.
New default-suite Fact TheRigsParentIsMadeBeforeItIsSweptAndSitsWhereTheTreesDo (order, dead pid swept, live pid kept, parent outside the Windows folder).
The _note and the R01 note no longer say CloudPlaceholderTests.cs is exempt.

CloudPlaceholderTests.cs removed from except_files and from the rule's `because`. The engine-appended WindowCases rule is deleted (M1). The RuleCases rule is kept, with a corrected note on comment blanking (m3).

The acceptance test, committed byte-identical to the repro's.

The m2 class corpus: census, sinks, aliases, plants, dynamic rows.

SL-098-TempRoots.Tests.ps1: a tree with a read-only file under a Deny-ListDirectory parent is removed with nothing counted. A plain recursive delete of the same shape is shown to refuse, so the shape is really fed.

SL-098-TempRoots.Tests.ps1: a junction to an outside folder holding a read-only and an ordinary file. The tree is removed; the target keeps both files and its read-only attribute. The walk is also fed on its own.
SL-098-TempRoots.Tests.ps1: a missing folder, and a folder removed twice, throw nothing and count nothing.
SL-098-TempRoots.Tests.ps1: a file held open with FileShare.None gives exactly one `cleanup:` count and no throw. The same call removes the tree once the handle is released.

SL-098-B008Root.Tests.ps1 -Temp Ordinary: with the user's TEMP the root is 250 and the length is 428, equal to the engine run (-Temp Both compares them). PASSED: B-008, exit 0.
WindowMutants.ps1 -Mutant All exits 0 with PASSED for all 12 mutants after the WindowCases.ps1 change.

New Fact CloudRigTests.TheRigsParentIsMadeBeforeItIsSweptAndSitsWhereTheTreesDo. The Core tests (CloudRigTests, TempTreeRootTests, LastAccessRuleCorpusTests) pass 132/132 under both TEMPs; the full solution passes 805/805 under TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP. harness.py --scenario all gives 117 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray hits with the exemption gone.

Case C-012 (WindowCases cloud roots) was dropped by decided finding M1: neither WindowCases listing looks for the rig's roots. Its slot went to Get-ScratchParent: 14 path-rule rows and 4 refusal rows in SL-098-TempRoots.Tests.ps1, under pwsh and powershell.exe 5.1.

Get-CloudRigParent, its contract, its case, its TempRoots check and the WindowCases fitness rule were not built. The engine-appended entry is deleted from .taad/fitness.yaml, whose only SL-098 entry now is the RuleCases rule. WindowCases changed only at the B-008 pad. The freed test slot checks Get-ScratchParent.
obligations.not_mutable: This fix is the removal of a function, a case and a rule that were never built. A test cannot observe an absence; the diff of .taad/fitness.yaml and WindowCases.ps1 shows it.

obligations.how: SL-076-ScratchKeptPath.Tests.ps1 now extracts Remove-ScratchDir and Get-ScratchParent beside Invoke-HarnessRaw, and also clean-ups with the helper. It passes under both TEMPs and both shells; before this it also failed under C:\WINDOWS\TEMP at HEAD (ShortName and its own Remove-Item).

Both helpers use only .NET Framework APIs: a drive/UNC regex stands in for IsPathFullyQualified, and attributes stand in for LinkTarget and EnumerationOptions. TempRoots repeats all its checks under powershell.exe 5.1. SettledCountProbe -Shape BothShells passes under both TEMPs, which it did not before the probe's own fix.

The check commands are wrapper scripts that set TEMP and TMP in the process environment and run `-File`; they never go through a quoted -Command. RuleCases prints `scratch: <root> (TEMP <GetTempPath()>)` and both wrappers assert the TEMP shown.

CloudRig.PrepareParent does DefaultTestsRoot, CreateDirectory, Sweep in one place, and SyncRootRig calls it. A default-suite Fact feeds a parent that does not exist yet (the Sweep control throws DirectoryNotFoundException), a dead-pid root and a live-pid root, under both TEMPs. The three-run Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT validate case from Q-086 is owed to validate; I did not run the opt-in filter, since it registers a real sync root (see follow_ups).

The fallback recurses by hand over GetFileSystemInfos (no attributes skipped) and unlinks each reparse point with a non-recursive Delete before the retry. The review was right that the first Delete unlinks the junction before stopping, so through Remove-ScratchDir the walk never meets one; TempRoots therefore extracts the nested walk and feeds it a junction directly. The target stays present and read-only.

Class: functions whose caller uses their return value and that print inside. The corpus is a closed census of every function in RuleCases.ps1 (a new function without a row fails), the printing spellings (reporting functions, Write-Output and aliases, New-Item/mkdir/md, `& $scriptblock`), 27 fire/quiet plants, and 9 dynamic rows. Fixed members: the scratch line uses Write-Host; Remove-ScratchDir at the Invoke-HarnessRaw call site and the early-return Check go to Out-Host; `& $change` goes to Out-Null. The design-literal pre-fix variants (Write-Output scratch line, no Out-Host at either site, no Out-Null) each fail named rows (D01, D08, D09, the census check).

The corrected claim is written where the next rule author will read it: the `because` of the RuleCases fitness rule now says Fitness blanks the comments of a .ps1 file unless including_comments is true, and that the line anchor is defence in depth.
obligations.not_mutable: A sentence in a rule's `because` text; no test observes it.

deviations: M1 (decided): Get-CloudRigParent, its contract, case, TempRoots check and the WindowCases fitness rule were not built, and the engine-appended rule entry was deleted. WindowCases.ps1 changes only at the B-008 pad.

Get-ScratchParent takes three optional parameters (temp, Windows folder, LocalAppData) so its branches are fed directly, and it reads LocalApplicationData with GetFolderPath, as TempTree does, instead of $env:LOCALAPPDATA. It returns the temp path as given, with its trailing separator, so a drive-root TEMP stays absolute.

SL-076-ScratchKeptPath.Tests.ps1 and SettledCountProbe.ps1 were changed more than the design said. The design asked SL-076 only to extract Remove-ScratchDir. I measured the HEAD copy of SL-076 under C:\WINDOWS\TEMP: it already failed there (ShortName finds no 8.3 name, its own cleanup is denied). SettledCountProbe -Shape BothShells exited 1 under that TEMP and left fsa-settled-probe-* folders. Both now use Get-ScratchParent and Remove-ScratchDir, so the M2/M3 commands can pass under both TEMPs.

m1: the review was right that Directory.Delete unlinks a junction before it stops on a read-only file. The walk's reparse rule is therefore tested by extracting the nested Open-Tree and feeding it a junction, not only through Remove-ScratchDir.

m2 'before' evidence uses the design-literal pre-fix variants (Write-Output scratch line, no Out-Host at the two sites, no Out-Null on `& $change`) built from the fixed file. HEAD never had a scratch line, so there was no HEAD code to fail the rows. Beyond the review's two sites I also fixed the early-return Check and `& $change` in New-RowsFile.

Check commands that need TEMP set (C-002, C-003, C-008, C-009) are wrapper scripts, SL-098-RuleCasesUnderTemps.Tests.ps1 and SL-098-B008Root.Tests.ps1, because a test_command cannot carry shell syntax and M4 forbids setting TEMP through a quoted -Command.

Standing rule on outside defects: no KnownWorkarounds entry or setting was built. The defect avoided (PowerShell's Remove-Item listing the parent) is avoided only in tests/rules and test scripts, which are not shipped, and the design decided this explicitly. A checkbox in the app's Settings window would govern nothing the app does. Recorded so a reviewer can overrule.

O-024 and O-025 are waived (SC-223, SC-224): the GuardRule check for the Remove-Item rule is not built, and the stale %TEMP% comments in CloudPlaceholderTests.cs:19, :251 and CloudRig.cs:10, :22 are left. Only the comment that said the rig was exempt was rewritten, and SystemRootTempRouteCorpus.json's two notes about the exemption were updated to match the fitness change.
not_built: Get-CloudRigParent and any change to WindowCases' fsa-cf listings (decided finding M1).
